profile.name: Pranay Patel
profile.description: I build scalable, responsive and user-friendly web applications that solve real-world problems and deliver meaningful digital experiences.

projects.title: Playmate
projects.subtitle: Sports Venue Booking & Community Platform
projects.description: A comprehensive platform for discovering and booking sports venues, managing team activities, and building a community of sports enthusiasts. Features real-time booking, payment processing via Razorpay, and community feeds.

projects.title: Amarjyot Timber
projects.subtitle: B2B Wood Processing Corporate Website
projects.description: A professional corporate website for a wood processing company, featuring product catalogs, inquiry forms with automated email notifications, and a responsive design optimized for B2B clients.

projects.title: Prescripto
projects.subtitle: Doctor Appointment Booking System
projects.description:
Designed a secure appointment system using the MERN stack with JWT authentication, REST APIs, payment gateway
integration, and Tailwind CSS interfaces for patients, doctors, and admins.

projects.title: Jobcard
projects.subtitle: AUTOMOBILE SERVICE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM | MERN
projects.description:
Built a full-stack service center platform to streamline vehicle repair tracking, customer records, and
billing.
Implemented role-based authentication (Admin/User) and dynamic receipt generation for printing job
cards and invoices.
Developed REST APIs for job card management, vehicle models, parts, labor, and payment tracking using
Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
